title: [25.24] Echoes from the deep! - A comprehensive Nautilus guide.
author: Aerenax

Alistar.summary: A skill matchup. Play around the cooldown of his W-Q combo, and watch out for Flash combos from good Alistars.

Amumu.summary: He stays right on top of you, which makes hooks awkward to land. Dodge his Q and then re-engage onto his carry.

Ashe.summary: Ashe is very squishy and your base damage is high, so almost any hook that lands on her should turn into a kill.

Bard.summary: He roams a lot and you will struggle to follow him. If you stay in lane, make the enemy ADC's life as hard as possible while he is gone.

Blitzcrank.summary: One of your easiest lanes. If he grabs your ADC, follow up with your own hook; if he grabs you, he has just brought you into range to lock him or his ADC down.

Brand.summary: He chips you down with constant poke, but if you catch him you can burst him. Stay patient and do not let your health drop too low before you find a hook.

Braum.summary: A failed engage gives him lots of ways to lock you down, and his shield absorbs a lot of your damage. Play around his E cooldown and you should win.

Fiddlesticks.summary: He controls the brushes and will fear you as soon as you go in, so tenacity is a strong pick. Once out of the fear you can cut his healing or interrupt his ultimate. Prioritize vision.

Janna.summary: She pokes with W and has timely disengage with Q or her ultimate. Patience is key; wait for those spells to be used before committing.

Karma.summary: She brings strong damage and utility. Avoid her empowered Q, and remember her shields mean she will not die instantly to your combo, so choose fights carefully.

Leona.summary: Her E lands her behind you, so you cannot use your hook to escape. Re-engaging is hard as well, so make sure you are the one who starts fights.

Lulu.summary: She will polymorph you and ult her carry, denying your burst. Bait those spells out before re-engaging.

Lux.summary: Her E is hard to dodge, but any hook on her should kill. Sidestep her Q and burst her.

Maokai.summary: He reaches you easily and has long CC with W and Q, but he lacks escape tools, so punish him when he commits.

Milio.summary: His Q can knock you away and cancel your hook pull, and his ultimate cleanses CC on his whole team. It cannot remove the knock-up from your ultimate, so lean on that.

Morgana.summary: Your worst matchup: her root lasts long, her shield blocks your engages, and she hits hard. The author bans her every game.

Nami.summary: Her slow, bubble stun and wave disengage make engaging hard. Play around her ultimate, which is ideal for stopping your engage.

Pantheon.summary: He deals heavy damage. Play around his W leap, interrupting it mid-air or as soon as he lands on your carry.

Poppy.summary: She disengages easily with W or her ultimate, and an aggressive Poppy uses W to stop you escaping with your hook.

Pyke.summary: Squishy but mobile. Catch him and burst him quickly; if you fail to finish him he regenerates, but you can try again.

Rakan.summary: Easy once you know it: hook him as he starts his ultimate engage. Getting charmed is fine if he is stopped too, and shutting down his engage wins fights.

Rell.summary: Her W has a slow wind-up that your hook can cancel. If she misses it, punish hard; doing this consistently wins the lane.

Renata.summary: Plays like a Lux: dodge her Q and E. Her W makes 2v2s much harder, and her ultimate can make your passive root your own allies.

Senna.summary: She outranges you heavily, deals lots of damage, and her W root is strong CC in lane. Expect a hard lane.

Seraphine.summary: She pokes from long range and sustains with W. If she misses her empowered E root or her ultimate, all-in her, but make sure you can kill her or her sustain will undo your damage.

Shaco.summary: His boxes block your hooks in lane, but he offers little in teamfights. Play around his stealth and punish him away from his boxes.

Sona.summary: Annoying poke but no CC besides her ultimate. Play around her cooldowns, respect the ultimate, and you should win most lanes.

Soraka.summary: One of the easiest matchups. Dodge her Q and she offers little; her E silence is the only thing that can stop your engage.

Swain.summary: He pulls you in with E or any lane CC and then bursts you, while you struggle to burst him back. Avoid his pull range.

TahmKench.summary: He walks up to stack his passive on you, and from level 6 he can protect his carry with his kit. Expect a tough lane.

Taric.summary: He sustains well and fights back on all-ins. Dodge his E stun, and back off when he ultimates, re-engaging after it expires.

Thresh.summary: Looks easy, but his E can cancel your hook follow-up and leave you open to his own hook. Respect the flay.

Velkoz.summary: His poke will likely push you under tower at half health. Learn his Q angles, play around his E, and hook him when his spells are down.

Xerath.summary: His passive refunds mana so he can keep poking. Dodge his spells and engage when he steps too far forward.

Yuumi.summary: She has little lane pressure, so pressure the enemy ADC hard; her healing cannot outpace your burst. Kill her when she detaches.

Zilean.summary: His bombs can stun you through minions, and his E slow is annoying. Stay away from your own minions and wait for him to overstep.

Zyra.summary: Her plants block your hook. Play around her E and punish misplaced plants or a missed E.
